filter: Features intersecting the mapped SRM University AP boundary or a 30 metre buffer around it, using UTM zone 44N for the buffer.
notes: Features are classified by their existing OpenStreetMap tags.
Some features intentionally occur in more than one thematic layer.
This is not yet a validated pedestrian routing graph; road/path connectivity and access need checking.
Only mapped OSM features are included; missing buildings and paths must be surveyed or added.
